description: Pinned workflow-only SDLC source: an unattended loop (pick, build or ship, black-box app check with fenced holdouts, review, merge gate) and a manager above it. Factory remains a thin consumer; workflow gates own decisions and scheduling is Animus's.

entries.animus-backlog: Slice a PRD into an ordered backlog of issues
entries.animus-holdouts: Write holdout scenarios from the product document (or an escaped defect) through the holdout-writer agent; nobody else reads them
entries.animus-loop: One move: pick routes it (finish open work, build simple work in the loop, or ship complex work), then a black-box app check and a reviewer that merges, sends back or returns to the owner. Parallel laps claim their work item and stay out of each other's way
entries.animus-manager: Step back on a slower schedule: steer the backlog, unstick work, ask the owner with a default, record metrics
entries.animus-ship-block: The complex route's pipeline: triage, investigate or plan, delivery rounds with review threads as work, CI, up to a ready pull request
entries.animus-deploy: Roll the default branch onto a running service and read the revision back
entries.animus-verify-runtime: Verify runtime scenarios with engine-owned agents
entries.animus-discoveries: Revalidate findings and optionally publish with gh
entries.animus-merge-queue: Assess and merge an authorized batch with gh
entries.animus-verify-runtime-suite: Run baseline and deliberate runtime controls
